Quick technical note on the BrightHealth SLA exception (cc: Monica) —

We can implement a cache bypass for that endpoint; it's straightforward (toggle at router layer) but it increases token spend and reduces cache hit rate for similar requests. Estimated perf/cost impact: 6–10% on the Dedicated pool during the 30-day window.

Risk: if we do the bypass without a fallback, the pool could breach target latency SLO for other customers in the same Dedicated shard. Proposed mitigation:
- Implement bypass + circuit-breaker: enable bypass for BrightHealth, track p95 latency; if p95 > 200ms for 3 consecutive 5-min windows, automatically revert.

If we treat this as an exec ask, we should include the mitigation and a cost estimate in the executive summary. I updated the ACTIONS tab (row 7) with the mitigation and a quick cost delta.

Aditya Rao
Senior Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
